note: AI 泡沫监测 11 个 curated-origin 指标的免费公开源候选矩阵。hybrid_live 表示 build 可先尝试公开源自动覆盖,失败仍 fail-closed 回到 config/bubble-watch-curated.json; candidate_only 表示已记录免费源,但还不够稳定,暂不自动改灯。

vc_ai_share.primarySignal: AI venture funding share of global VC dollars

freeSourceCandidates.source: Crunchbase News WordPress API
freeSourceCandidates.role: public article parser for AI funding dollars and share
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Crunchbase article text can move; PitchBook remains paywalled and is not scraped.

ai_ipo_pipeline.primarySignal: AI IPO / exit pipeline heat from public startup-market reporting

freeSourceCandidates.source: Crunchbase News WordPress API
freeSourceCandidates.role: public article search for AI IPO / blockbuster-exit language
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Counts evidence headlines, not a formal IPO calendar; classification remains conservative.

freeSourceCandidates.source: SEC EDGAR company submissions
freeSourceCandidates.role: future candidate for S-1 filing confirmation
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Needs issuer allowlist and filing-form normalization before automatic use.

freeSourceCandidates.source: CRE Finance Council Data Center e-primer PDF
freeSourceCandidates.role: public issuance-size and market-structure context for data-center securitization
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Provides issuance scale and structural context, not a weekly comparable spread series.

freeSourceCandidates.source: Green Street News / public article snippets
freeSourceCandidates.role: public spread-direction mentions
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Continuous spread data appears research/paywalled; do not auto-score without a public numeric series.

freeSourceCandidates.source: KBRA / Morningstar public presale and rating headlines
freeSourceCandidates.role: deal/rating evidence
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Evidence of issuance quality, not a comparable spread index.

freeSourceCandidates.source: Fitch / S&P / KBRA public data-center presale headlines
freeSourceCandidates.role: candidate monitor for new data-center ABS/CMBS issuance and rating changes
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Presale headlines are useful event evidence but do not expose a free continuous spread history; keep candidate_only for spread direction.

neocloud_credit.primarySignal: Default, downgrade, distressed financing or rating event among neocloud names

freeSourceCandidates.source: Company IR / SEC / rating-agency public headlines
freeSourceCandidates.role: event watchlist for CoreWeave / Nebius / Crusoe / Lambda
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Negative-event absence requires broad watchlist and search hygiene; keep curated until a robust monitor is reviewed.

freeSourceCandidates.source: CoreWeave investor relations / public debt-financing releases
freeSourceCandidates.role: public-company financing and notes event monitor
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: News list is widget-driven and individual release pages can be Cloudflare-blocked; better as reviewed event evidence than hard weekly auto.

freeSourceCandidates.source: Nebius newsroom / investor hub public releases
freeSourceCandidates.role: public-company financing update monitor
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Captures company-disclosed financing plans, not rating-agency downgrades across the whole neocloud universe.

freeSourceCandidates.source: Fitch / S&P / Moody's public rating headlines
freeSourceCandidates.role: rating-action and debt-rating event monitor
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Some pages are client-rendered, paywalled, or search-index-visible but not reliably machine-readable from CI; keep candidate_only until a stable public feed is reviewed.

freeSourceCandidates.source: OpenRouter public rankings API
freeSourceCandidates.role: weekly provider-level token volume proxy, summed into 4w/4w growth
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: OpenRouter platform proxy, not full-industry token tape; endpoint is frontend-public and can change without notice.

freeSourceCandidates.source: OpenRouter State of AI report
freeSourceCandidates.role: methodology and cross-check for token-volume interpretation
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Low-frequency report; useful for calibration, not weekly production values.

token_revenue_ratio.primarySignal: Token growth versus reported or estimated AI revenue growth

freeSourceCandidates.source: OpenRouter public rankings API + public model pricing catalog
freeSourceCandidates.role: future token/spend proxy for numerator; could combine model token counts with public pricing
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Spend proxy would be OpenRouter-only and still would not equal vendor revenue; denominator requires stable public revenue panel.

freeSourceCandidates.source: Menlo Ventures State of Generative AI in the Enterprise
freeSourceCandidates.role: enterprise GenAI spend growth benchmark
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Low frequency and survey/model-estimate driven; not enough for weekly token/revenue ratio automation.

arr_2nd_deriv.primarySignal: Second derivative of AI ARR / run-rate estimates

freeSourceCandidates.source: Sacra / public reporting / company disclosures
freeSourceCandidates.role: private-company revenue estimate evidence
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Usually estimate-driven and partly paywalled; not safe for hard automatic scoring yet.

freeSourceCandidates.source: Public company RPO / AI revenue disclosures via SEC or company IR
freeSourceCandidates.role: future public-company AI revenue acceleration panel
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Does not cover private OpenAI/Anthropic/Sacra-style ARR directly; requires issuer taxonomy and backtest before auto.

freeSourceCandidates.source: Menlo Ventures enterprise GenAI spend report
freeSourceCandidates.role: spend-growth proxy for AI application layer
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Not ARR, not company-level, and too low-frequency for weekly second-derivative classification.

freeSourceCandidates.source: Google Cloud ROI of AI public report
freeSourceCandidates.role: production AI-agent deployment percentage proxy
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Executive survey / Google Cloud framing; production AI agents are narrower than all enterprise AI production use cases.

freeSourceCandidates.source: Deloitte State of AI in the Enterprise
freeSourceCandidates.role: cross-check for production-project scaling trend
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Provides directional production-project context; not always a single comparable percentage.

freeSourceCandidates.source: McKinsey State of AI / Deloitte State of Generative AI reports
freeSourceCandidates.role: survey benchmark
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Low frequency and access can block data-center fetches; used only as calibration/cross-check, not primary weekly source.

accounting_events.primarySignal: Formal SEC / DOJ accounting, fraud, round-tripping or enforcement event tied to core AI names

freeSourceCandidates.source: SEC press releases
freeSourceCandidates.role: formal enforcement search
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Search text must be treated as event evidence, not proof of no misconduct outside SEC coverage.

freeSourceCandidates.source: DOJ press releases
freeSourceCandidates.role: criminal enforcement search
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Generic search pages can be sparse; absence is only a watchlist signal.

capex_reaction.primarySignal: Market reaction to AI capex guidance

freeSourceCandidates.source: Yahoo Chart around earnings dates + earnings-call guidance text
freeSourceCandidates.role: future event-window return calculator
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Needs earnings-date calendar and capex-guidance text extraction before automatic classification.

freeSourceCandidates.source: Yahoo Chart API + manually reviewed earnings-date panel
freeSourceCandidates.role: candidate event-window return proxy for AI capex guidance reactions
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Yahoo quoteSummary/calendar endpoints require crumb or fail in CI; without a reliable earnings calendar and text parser this remains candidate_only.

freeSourceCandidates.source: Company IR earnings releases / transcripts
freeSourceCandidates.role: future capex-guidance text extraction
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Requires issuer-specific pages and guidance-language classifier; not safe for weekly auto until source-reviewed.

ceo_hedging.primarySignal: CEO / senior-executive bubble-risk or overheat language frequency

freeSourceCandidates.source: GDELT DOC 2.0 public news search
freeSourceCandidates.role: public-news evidence counter for AI bubble / irrational / overbuild language
freeSourceCandidates.limitations: Rate-limited and media-driven; automatic result remains conservative and falls back on failure.
